title: Shopping AdvenTOUR with Dessert at Cretia's Bakery
includes: Photo ops including the Dallas Skyline
Tour Booklet w/ the History of each Mall (available in different languages upon request)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Dallas through its most iconic shopping destinations on this fun, guided shopping adventure! Browse luxury brands at NorthPark Center, shop artisan vendors at the Dallas Farmers Market, and find authentic Texas souvenirs at Wild Bill's Western Store.

Enjoy a narrated drive through historic Downtown Dallas featuring the legendary Neiman Marcus flagship, then enjoy dessert at Cretia's Bakery before exploring the local shops of the Bishop Arts District. We'll wrap up with a photo stop at the Ron Kirk Bridge, offering one of the city's best skyline views.

Sit back, relax, and let us handle the driving while you enjoy shopping, local stories, trivia, and unforgettable Dallas experiences.

What's Included:
✔️ Roundtrip transportation in an air-conditioned vehicle
✔️ Lunch reservation at Cretia's (meal not included)
✔️ Dallas shopping trivia and fun facts
✔️ Ron Kirk Bridge skyline photo stop
✔️ Tour booklet with history and highlights of each stop
✔️ Bottled water and snacks
